location.ref: song 'hari din to gela, sandhyā holo, pār karo āmāre'

paraphrase: Hari, the day is gone and evening has come — take me across; you are the ferryman of the far shore, I have heard that you ferry the poor.
speaker: Kāṅgāl Harināth

original.text: hari dina to gela, sandhyā hala, pāra kara āmāre
original.edition: popular printed and sung form; wording varies between editions and singers

translation_basis: paraphrase from memory of the vernacular text (Phase B skeleton); to be checked against an edition in Phase D
